translations.web: then will we give our daughters to you; and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.
translations.bsb: Then we will give you our daughters and take your daughters for ourselves. We will dwell among you and become one people.
translations.kjv: Then will we give our daughters unto you, and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.
translations.asv: then will we give our daughters unto you, and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.
